# Laura

Laura is a TUI workspace that provides agents with an **API over the TUI**, allowing them to dynamically tile panes while pair-programming.

## Docs

- [Tutorial](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/tutorial.md): A step-by-step walkthrough for users.
- [Navigating the TUI](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/navigation.md): The keystrokes to navigate within a Laura workspace for users.
- [Web app](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/web-app.md): How to start a Laura workspace in a browser tab and review files there, for users (experimental).
- [Navigating the web app](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/web-app-navigation.md): The keystrokes, clicks, pane header, status bar and file rendering in the web app, for users (experimental).
- [Agent reference](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/agent-reference.md): Common usage reference for the `laura` CLI for agents.
- [CLI reference](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/cli.md): Complete reference of the `laura` CLI commands and flags for agents.
- [Protocol](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/protocol.md): How tiling and interactions work across processes for agents.
